# gtm_v1_account (Data Source)

Gets a GTM Account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The GTM Account ID. The response value is returned in the same attribute.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) The fingerprint of the GTM Account as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the account is modified.
- `name` (String) Account display name.
- `share_data` (Boolean) Whether the account shares data anonymously with Google and others.
